answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where identity is tethered to capital collateral rather than ephemeral compute. Like a karst landscape eroding under pressure, attackers face financial exhaustion if they attempt to flood the network with fake nodes. Each agent must stake assets to secure the reef of valid transactions, essentially acting as a pigment that colors the chain with verifiable truth. The cost to the attacker is the direct forfeiture of their staked wealth upon detected dishonesty.
